task: Aβ42 aggregation kinetics: nucleation-elongation-secondary-nucleation master equation (Knowles/Cohen framework), the Aβ42-vs-Aβ40 aggregation-propensity difference, concentration-dependent lag time, and a decorrelated in-vivo check (CSF Aβ42 decrease + Aβ42/Aβ40 ratio vs amyloid-PET).
confidence_tier: in-vitro-anchored (ThT kinetics: Cohen 2013 PNAS, Meisl 2014 PNAS) + in-vivo biomarker (CSF/PET: Olsson 2016 Lancet Neurol, Janelidze 2016 ACTN, Hansson 2018 Alz&Dem) -- reported as two DECORRELATED tiers, never fused into one score. In-vitro kinetics reproducibility across labs/seeds/agitation is explicitly NOT tested and held OPEN.

jarrett1993.cite: Jarrett JT, Berger EP, Lansbury PT Jr (1993). The carboxy terminus of the beta amyloid protein is critical for the seeding of amyloid formation: implications for the pathogenesis of Alzheimer's disease. Biochemistry 32(18):4693-4697.
jarrett1993.numbers: Classic historical/qualitative anchor: amyloid formation is nucleation-dependent (crystallization-like); beta1-42/43 (and model peptides retaining the critical C-terminal residues) can SEED aggregation of the kinetically-soluble beta1-39/40; beta1-42/43, not beta1-40, proposed as the pathogenic species. No numeric fold-difference extracted from the abstract (pre-web era paper; full text not fetched).

bitan2003.cite: Bitan G, Kirkitadze MD, Lomakin A, Vollers SS, Benedek GB, Teplow DB (2003). Amyloid β-protein (Aβ) assembly: Aβ40 and Aβ42 oligomerize through distinct pathways. PNAS 100(1):330-335.
bitan2003.numbers: DECORRELATED structural anchor (PICUP photo-crosslinking + size-exclusion chromatography + dynamic light scattering + circular dichroism + electron microscopy -- NOT ThT fluorescence kinetics): Abeta40 = monomer/dimer/trimer/tetramer rapid equilibrium; Abeta42 = distinct pentamer/hexamer 'paranuclei' pathway -> protofibril-like beaded superstructures. Ile-41 addition to Abeta40 sufficient to induce paranuclei; Ala-42 required for their further association. Independent technique, same Abeta42-more-aggregation-prone DIRECTION as the kinetic (ThT) findings.

jack2013.cite: Jack CR Jr, Knopman DS, Jagust WJ, et al. (2013). Tracking pathophysiological processes in Alzheimer's disease: an updated hypothetical model of dynamic biomarkers. Lancet Neurology 12(2):207-216.

jack2013.numbers: Cascade/couples_to anchor, quoted directly: 'CSF Abeta42 and amyloid PET are dynamic earliest followed by CSF tau and FDG PET, then structural MRI, followed by clinical symptoms' / 'the sequence of events...is Abeta pathophysiology first, then tau related neurodegeneration.' Symmetric-QC caveat, the paper's OWN disclosed complexity, not omitted here: autopsy evidence in some young individuals shows AD-like subcortical tauopathy CAN PRECEDE Abeta deposition -- a population-level tendency in the paper's model, not a universal per-individual law; the paper's own 'Model incorporating tau and Abeta as independent processes' section addresses this directly.

geometric_derivation.method: Linearize the (P,M) master-equation system (P=fibril-end number concentration, M=fibril mass concentration) at early time around the unseeded fixed point; the 2x2 Jacobian's eigenvalue kappa=sqrt(2*(k+*k2)*m0^(n2+1)) governs exponential growth M(t)~exp(kappa*t), so the half-time inherits t_1/2 ~ kappa^-1 ~ m0^-(n2+1)/2. Derived from scratch (2x2 Jacobian eigenvalue), not copied from a paper, THEN cross-checked against both Cohen 2013 PNAS's own stated formula and Meisl 2014 PNAS's own Eq. 11 -- both independently confirm the identical exponent formula in both the unsaturated and saturated limits.
geometric_derivation.self_consistency_check: Numerically-fit early-time P'(t) exponential growth rate vs the closed-form kappa, at m0=4uM, kn_comb=0 (pure-secondary limit): fit=0.00226274 s^-1, theory=0.00226274 s^-1, relative error 1.234e-7 -- PASS (two independent computational paths: numerical ODE integration + fitted log-slope, vs a closed-form eigenvalue).

falsifier_part2_Abeta42.pre_registered_threshold: Simulated log-log slope gamma (m0=1-8uM, using Cohen 2013's own untuned combined rate constants for the full/winning model) must fall in [-1.7,-1.1], bracketing both the measured -1.33+/-0.03 and the pure-theory -1.5.
falsifier_part2_Abeta42.forced_adversary: Cohen 2013's OWN fitted no-secondary-nucleation alternative (Fig.1 panel B: primary-nucleation-only, elevated order nc=3, k2=0) run through the IDENTICAL ODE code.
falsifier_part2_Abeta42.adversary_r2_is_exact_by_scale_invarianc: A single-power-law-only ODE (kn_comb*m^nc term alone, no secondary term) has NO timescale other than the one set by m0, so it is exactly self-similar under (t,M)->(t/T(m0), M/m0) for any conversion-fraction threshold -- R2=1.0 is an algebraic consequence, not a fitting artifact, and was confirmed by this reasoning, not just observed.
falsifier_part2_Abeta42.honest_reframe: This session pre-registered a concern that slope alone might be degenerate (an adversary could always choose nc to mimic any target). That did not concretely occur in this specific (non-reverse-fitted, each side using its own independently-reported order) comparison -- 0.18 gap vs 0.03 measured precision is resolvable. The CONCEPTUAL vulnerability remains real in the abstract (nothing stops a differently-chosen nc), which is why the shape metric below, not the slope alone, is treated as the decisive discriminator.
falsifier_part2_Abeta42.interpretation: Matches Cohen 2013's own qualitative statement (verified live) that a no-secondary-pathway fit 'is not able to describe even qualitatively the full time courses' -- machine-computed here as a 2.4x more gradual normalized transition for the adversary.

falsifier_part3_Abeta40_vs_Abeta42.pre_registered_threshold: Simulated t_half(Abeta40)/t_half(Abeta42) at matched 3.5uM concentration in [3,300] (deliberately wide -- Abeta40's exact fitted rate-constant table (Fig.3B) is a rendered graphic, not machine-extractable this session; reconstruction uses only Meisl 2014's qualitative order-of-magnitude statements).
falsifier_part3_Abeta40_vs_Abeta42.curvature_threshold: R2 gap (Abeta42 clean single-power-law fit R2 minus Abeta40 full-range single-power-law fit R2) >= 1e-4
falsifier_part3_Abeta40_vs_Abeta42.interpretation: Low-conc bucket (3.5-10uM) straddles the KM=31uM^2 crossover (sqrt(31)=5.6uM), so its slope (-1.01) sits between the -1.5/-0.5 asymptotes rather than cleanly at -1.5 -- an honest, disclosed feature of the real (not idealized) concentration grid, not a bug.

overall_verdict.note: Every PASS above is machine-computed from either (a) this session's own from-scratch ODE simulation using untuned literature rate constants, or (b) numbers extracted directly from live-fetched primary-source text/images/tables -- none is a recalled or assumed number. No claim in this object should be read as resolving disease-CAUSALITY priority (amyloid vs tau vs neuroinflammation) -- that adjudication is out of scope, held in NEU-ALZHEIMERS-MULTIMODAL.

symmetric_qc_open_items: In-vitro ThT kinetics is highly prep/seed/agitation-sensitive (Cohen 2013's own shear-series shows gamma itself drifting from -1.33 toward -0.5 under agitation) -- cross-lab/cross-batch reproducibility of absolute rate constants is NOT tested here, held explicitly OPEN per the task brief.
In-vitro aggregation kinetics (hours) is NOT claimed to govern in-vivo plaque deposition timescale (years-to-decades) -- the two are decorrelated by design, not fused.

The elongation rate constant k+ is never individually assumed (removed via the P'=k+P rescaling) -- but this also means k+ itself is not independently verified, only the combined constants and reaction orders.

Abeta40's exact Fig.3B fitted rate-constant table was not machine-extractable this session (rendered graphic, not text or a small inline-math image) -- the Abeta40 reconstruction is order-of-magnitude, disclosed as such, not digit-exact.

The 4.90x Abeta40/Abeta42 matched-concentration fold-difference is this session's own simulated PREDICTION from the order-of-magnitude reconstruction, not an independently-cited literature fold-number -- no single citable 'Abeta40 is Nx slower' headline figure was found/verified to check it against directly.

Slope-alone is a conceptually gameable discriminator (an adversary could in principle choose a reaction order to mimic any target slope); this session's own forced comparison did not concretely exhibit that degeneracy, but the shape-metric check, not the slope, is treated as the decisive falsifier for that reason.
Amyloid-PET is treated as a real, independent, but imperfect anchor (tracer/threshold-dependent), not infallible ground truth.
No claim resolves amyloid-vs-tau-vs-neuroinflammation disease-causality priority -- explicitly out of scope, deferred to the existing NEU-ALZHEIMERS-MULTIMODAL node.

Knowles 2009 Science (the foundational analytical-solution paper) was PMID/DOI-verified live but its full text was not independently fetched this session (not available via the PMC/EuropePMC routes tried); its formulas were cross-verified instead via two later papers (Cohen 2013, Meisl 2014) that both restate and cite it, and whose full texts WERE fetched live.

Numerical half-time extraction carries a few-percent grid-discretization sensitivity (directly checked: changing the adaptive-integration stop fraction shifted one reported t_half by ~3%); every pre-registered threshold band in this doc has margin >=10x that noise floor.
